description: What did a person say, object to or agree with: the stance sentences of their own words in the mail, labelled by rule. "What did Tom Lane object to in SIGFPE handling": person + topic. "Who objected to what in this thread", "why did this patch stall": thread (every participant; add person for one). Each sentence is verbatim own text (quotes, signature and patch removed; whitespace collapsed) with message_id, url, date and from; stance is opposes, concerned, supports or commits, with the cue that fired and source: rule (a cue word such as "I'm not convinced", "-1", "makes sense"), or source: commitfest (the status a commitfest-app review set: Waiting on Author is concerned, Ready for Committer supports). A label is a rule's classification, not a statement of the person's view: read the sentence. Threads come in search order with a topic, else newest first; inside a thread objections first. counts by stance; messages_read (at most 400 per call) and complete=false when a cap or budget_ms cut the read, or when the author-filtered search found nothing in time and the topic alone chose the threads (note says which). Sentences without a cue word are not returned: an argument made without one is missed (read the message). Hidden and taken-down mail is never returned. At most 4 run at once; past that the call returns busy (retry).

budget_ms.description: Time budget in ms (100-15000, default 3000). complete=false when it ran out.

inbox.description: One mailing list, e.g. pgsql-hackers. Default: every list.

person.description: A name, an e-mail address or hash:<8 hex> (one person, as whats_new resolves them).

since.description: Only mail from this date (YYYY, YYYY-MM, YYYY-MM-DD, an ISO date-time, or 2w / 6m / 1y ago).

thread.description: A Message-ID or an archive URL of any message in the thread: its whole thread, on the list search shows.

topic.description: Words or a question; with person, their messages on it (hybrid search, every message rather than one per thread).

until.description: Only mail before this date (same forms as since).

name: said
